direct.notes: Canonical on-thread solver request. Function-valued research/test observers are allowed.

webWorker.notes: Full structured-cloneable SolveOpts forwarded; timeBudgetMs/yieldFn use dedicated transport semantics; function-valued options rejected.

backendSpecificFields.note: Not a SolveOpts field; phase-1 hard wall cap for raced engine.

backendSpecificFields.effect: changes attempt concurrency and first-success winner opportunity

raced.notes: First-success raced engine supports only main-search + repair-fallback + goal-attraction-disabled-retry stages and does not promise stable winner identity.
raced.reproducibilitySemantics: first-success-wins; pool scheduling may change the winning attempt/path even with otherwise equivalent request content

observerRule: Read-only/diagnostic instrumentation is policy-inert, not automatically outcome-inert. Under binding wall-clock termination observer overhead can change reached work/opportunity; comparability requires parity evidence or deterministic/non-binding execution conditions.

identityDesign.commonRequestIdentity: projection of all classified outcome-affecting common fields, preserving semantic defaults and identity algorithm version
identityDesign.executionIdentity: common request identity + backend-specific request + backend/reproducibility mode + immutable solver ref
identityDesign.evidenceIdentity: execution identity + level revision + per-attempt action/forcing/seed dimensions as needed
identityDesign.ciRule: Any new SolveOpts field or backend request field must be classified before identity tests pass.
identityDesign.defaultRule: Identity canonicalization must operate on normalized effective values. Omitted input and explicit canonical default compare equal only where the canonical owner proves they are semantically equivalent; ablation opt-in defaults must come from normalizeAblationConfig/OPT_IN_FEATURES, never generic boolean filling.
identityDesign.levelDerivedRule: primeAttempt and adaptive/per-level allocations must be represented at effective-input/evidence identity after derivation, not confused with run-wide request identity.
identityDesign.wallReactiveObserverRule: Observer/counter presence belongs in execution comparability whenever a binding wall deadline can make observer overhead outcome-affecting, even if the observer is search-policy inert.

enforcementStatus.canonicalDefaults: not yet exhaustive; must be derived from canonical normalization/solver behavior rather than guessed from interface optionality
enforcementStatus.backendSupport: direct/worker contracts are canonical; raced support is mechanically owned by RACE_LEVEL_OPTS_FIELDS/toRaceLevelOpts and must not be copied into a second hand-maintained allowlist
enforcementStatus.phaseMinus1Gate: add a validator that fails when SolveOpts membership, race boundary fields, or backend-specific request fields change without a matching semantic classification
enforcementStatus.identityClassification: all 49 SolveOpts fields now have a source-owned default-semantics statement, identity layer, and direct/worker/raced support classification; validation script still needed to fail CI on drift

backendSemanticGaps.finding: buildWorkerSolveOpts forwards these plain mutable objects because they are structured-cloneable, but the worker mutates only its clone and SolveResult does not return them. A caller can therefore request them without an error and observe no updates.
backendSemanticGaps.target: classify them direct-only and reject at worker ingress, or add an explicit returned telemetry projection; do not call structured-clone transport equivalent to direct side-effect semantics.
